title: (RHEA-2019:1903) s390utils enhancement update
portal_summary: Updated s390utils packages that add one enhancement are now available for Red Hat Enterprise Linux 7.
portal_product_filter: Red Hat Enterprise Linux|Red Hat Enterprise Linux for IBM System z (Structure A)|7|s390x
portal_solution:
Before applying this update, make sure all previously released errata
relevant to your system have been applied.

For details on how to apply this update, refer to:

https://access.redhat.com/articles/11258
portal_description:
The s390utils packages contain a set of user-space utilities that should be used together with the zSeries (s390) Linux kernel and device drivers.

This update adds the following enhancement:

* RHEL-Alt-7.6 Alpha - s390utils package is not installing infrastructure for secure key repository (directory structure) (crypto) (BZ#1612968)

Users of s390utils are advised to upgrade to these updated packages, which add this enhancement.
